independence_and_limits: Byte replays rerun the lane's own enumerator code (pinned S copies, equal to live L at every case); they show determinism and binding of each stored list to its pinned spec/skeleton and code, not correctness.

The independent semantics (code/r6_indep.py) is parent-written, stdlib only, and shares no code with extend_p1/extend_p1q/extend_b; it does not import networkx or nauty. It restates the same placement conditions (block sizes 4/4/2, no common P0 quad inside a block, row budget with `left` free P1 columns) from the lane README A3; those formulas are therefore shared with all three enumerators and were re-derived by hand, not machine-checked.

Orbit counts: extend_p1/extend_p1q use networkx weisfeiler_lehman_graph_hash + is_isomorphic (imported, networkx 3.7 pinned by tree digest); extend_b uses canonical minima over a brute-force automorphism group; r6_indep uses union-find over generators of a brute-force automorphism group and Burnside's lemma. All three agree on every processed case.

The count-vector reduction (rows with equal P0 set are interchangeable) is shared by extend_b and r6_indep. It is checked without that reduction by row-level labeled enumeration: full labeled orbit counts (union-find over row generators) for all 31 ms01 cases; for ms09 only the labeled count equals the multinomial weight sum of the count vectors (labeled sets are 1e7+), which with realizability forces the count-vector set but does not by itself recount ms09 orbits at row level.

The A->B map (compare-map a_to_b, made with networkx in compare_skel.py) is validated per case by explicit P0-column isomorphisms found by brute force over c0! permutations; transported count-vector sets equal the M2 sets and every M1 list maps bijectively onto the M2 orbits.

The interpreter used by the production M2 runner is not recorded by the lane; extend_b is stdlib-only and the stored M2 lists that exist are byte-identical to the venv-python regeneration after the source-path substitution.
Placement completeness is relative to the stated necessary conditions and to the skeleton list (R3/R4); it says nothing about the solved status of any subcase.
